_comment: Fill all required fields (*). Optional fields may be omitted.
_property_address_note: * Required — e.g. '3213 Cliff Drive, Santa Barbara, CA'
_footage_directory_note: * Required — absolute path to raw video clips directory
_stills_directory_note: Absolute path to property photos (required only for ai_lot or if synthetic generation may be needed)
_target_duration_note: * Required — target final video duration in seconds (e.g. 30, 60, 90)
_delivery_format_note: * Required — define output format. Use 9:16 / 1080x1920 for Instagram Reels, 16:9 / 1920x1080 for MLS/YouTube.
_music_style_note: Music mood/genre directive, e.g. 'uplifting modern 120-130 BPM' or 'cinematic instrumental'
_caption_required_note: Set true to enable text captions and graphics stage
_quality_gates_note: Override default gate thresholds if needed. Defaults shown above.
_special_instructions_note: Any additional directives for the pipeline (e.g. 'feature pool prominently', 'signature cinematic look')
